workarounds.symptom: mastra @mastra/core@1.79.0: Fixed `UnixSocketPubSub` intermittently failing to start a broker when the socket path is a bare relative name like `events.sock` or `./events.sock`. The broker's random private so
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fixed `UnixSocketPubSub` intermittently failing to start a broker when the socket path is a bare relative name like `events.sock` or `./events.sock`. The broker's random private socket name could look like a number (for example `.28381e422682`), which Node treated as a TCP port and rejected `subscribe()` with `ERR_SOCKET_BAD_PORT` or `ENOENT`. The private socket path now always keeps its `./` prefix. (#27894). Upstream PR #27894. (Ref: https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/27894)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fixed a TypeScript error (TS2345) when chaining processor steps with `.then()` or `.parallel()`. Steps built with `createStep(processor)` now accept the output of a previous processor step, so the output guardrails workflow from the docs type-checks: (#27764). Upstream PR #27764. (Ref: https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/27764)

workarounds.symptom: mastra @mastra/core@1.79.0: Fixed client tools failing with `ToolNotFoundError` after a tool approval. `approveToolCall`, `declineToolCall`, `approveToolCallGenerate` and `declineToolCallGenerate` now accept
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fixed client tools failing with `ToolNotFoundError` after a tool approval. `approveToolCall`, `declineToolCall`, `approveToolCallGenerate` and `declineToolCallGenerate` now accept `clientTools` (and `clientToolsResolver`) and send them to the server, so the model can call a client tool after the approval decision. `approveToolCall` and `declineToolCall` also accept `memory`; pass the same thread and resource as the original call so client-tool results and the final answer are saved to that thread. (#27744). Upstream PR #27744. (Ref: https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/27744)

workarounds.symptom: mastra @mastra/core@1.78.0: Fixed revoked or invalid OAuth sign-ins showing a raw API error. When Anthropic, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, xAI, or Kimi For Coding rejects a stored sign-in with a 401, the erro
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fixed revoked or invalid OAuth sign-ins showing a raw API error. When Anthropic, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, xAI, or Kimi For Coding rejects a stored sign-in with a 401, the error is now a `ProviderAuthRequiredError` that says the sign-in was rejected, the same as a missing sign-in. Hosts can match on the error name to prompt the user to sign in again. (#27187). Upstream PR #27187. (Ref: https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/27187)

workarounds.symptom: mastra @mastra/core@1.78.0: Fixed `FileTransport` and `UpstashTransport` log queries accepting invalid `page`/`perPage` values. `listLogs` and `listLogsByRunId` now throw a `RangeError` for negative, fraction
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fixed `FileTransport` and `UpstashTransport` log queries accepting invalid `page`/`perPage` values. `listLogs` and `listLogsByRunId` now throw a `RangeError` for negative, fractional, non-finite, or unsafe pagination values instead of silently returning misleading results or sending malformed Redis ranges. `page: 0` and `perPage: 0` still default to page 1 and 100 per page. (#27175). Upstream PR #27175. (Ref: https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/27175)

workarounds.symptom: mastra @mastra/core@1.78.0: Fixed agent runs crashing with `RangeError: Invalid string length` when a command printed a very large amount of output. `sandbox.executeCommand()` now keeps the newest 1 MiB of st
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fixed agent runs crashing with `RangeError: Invalid string length` when a command printed a very large amount of output. `sandbox.executeCommand()` now keeps the newest 1 MiB of stdout and stderr by default, the same limit spawned processes already use. Streaming callbacks still receive every chunk, and the result reports `stdoutTruncated` and `stdoutDroppedBytes` (and the stderr equivalents) when output was dropped. (#27106). Upstream PR #27106. (Ref: https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/27106)
